posts.text:
Today’s a special day for us, and it’s not just because of my birthday…
It’s the first day of early in-person voting! We’re celebrating by asking our supporters to donate, vote, and volunteer. 
A contribution would help ensure we get across the finish line on August 4th. Your support is the best gift I could ask for.
If you voted today, tag us!
